title: Quickstart contract resolves native empty values and individual HTML and block occurrences before paid calls
expect: Missing native paths are unresolved even when contract sample is empty.
Observed empty values remain empty and unpublished entities require native proof.
XPath metadata applies only to the correct text occurrence after photo URL lengths change.
Media descriptors cannot override editorial roles; missing block attributes remain unresolved.
All picture preflight problems are reported before vision or uploads.
